replicate_statements: Distribution of SMF-derived promoter state frequencies as a function of Pol II ChIP-seq level in Drosophila promoters (n = 5912 promoters).
Promoters were first binned based on their log2 Pol II ChIP-seq signal. Within each bin, the median frequency of each of the promoter state was calculated.
outputs.explanation: The panel aggregates median promoter-state frequencies across promoters binned by Pol II ChIP-seq level; the caption explicitly reports n = 5912 promoters as the replicate unit and type.

replicate_statements: 2952 molecules (stated on the y-axis of the single-molecule stack image)
outputs.explanation: Although this is a single representative locus, the state-frequency percentages shown are quantified across the individual DNA molecules whose number (2952 molecules) and type (single DNA molecules) are explicitly reported on the panel.

replicate_statements: Distribution of SMF-derived state frequencies as a function of Pol II ChIP-seq level in mouse promoters (n = 6122 promoters).
outputs.explanation: The caption explicitly reports n = 6122 promoters as the unit underlying the median state-frequency bars, matching the reporting in panel A.

replicate_statements: 2871 molecules (stated on the y-axis of the single-molecule stack image)
outputs.explanation: As in panel B, the number (2871) and type (single DNA molecules) of the units underlying the quantified state frequencies are explicitly reported on the panel.

replicate_statements: Comparison of PIC state frequency between mouse (TATA-less n = 572 promoters; TATA-containing n = 64 promoters) and Drosophila (TATA-less n = 422 promoters; TATA-containing n = 71 promoters) promoters.
The statistical comparisons between groups were performed using the Wilcoxon rank-sum test.
outputs.explanation: Boxplots with statistical comparisons report explicit n values (promoters) for each of the four groups being compared, with the lowest being n = 64 for mouse TATA-containing promoters.
